name: OmaVST
author: FenrirRhogar
description: Plugin manager for Linux music producers: Windows plugins (yabridge) and native VST3/CLAP/LV2 plugins in one searchable list. Sync, disable, remove, install from a Windows installer, back up the Wine prefix, and spot plugins that crash.

barWidget.description: Your audio plugins at a glance; highlights when plugins need a yabridge sync.
